name: SciAssess
description: Recent breakthroughs in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized scientific literature analysis. However, existing benchmarks fail to adequately evaluate the proficiency of LLMs in this domain, particularly in scenarios requiring higher-level abilities beyond mere memorization and the handling of multimodal data. In response to this gap, we introduce SciAssess, a benchmark specifically designed for the comprehensive evaluation of LLMs in scientific literature analysis.
reputation: A recent research benchmark for scientific literature analysis that is cited in the LLM-for-science literature but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Likely includes heterogeneous sub-tasks and multimodal inputs; reported scores are not directly comparable across all subsets.
